field.label: Protocol
field.comment: Protocol for server-side indexing. Use 'http' for local/Docker setups, 'https' for production.

field.label: Host
field.comment: Internal hostname for indexing (e.g., 'typesense' in Docker, 'search.example.com' in production). Used by PHP for indexing, not by the browser.

field.label: Port
field.comment: Default Typesense port is 8108.

field.label: Admin API Key
field.comment: Full-access key for indexing and collection management. Found in your Typesense server startup flags (--api-key). Never exposed to the frontend.

field.label: Search-Only API Key
field.comment: Read-only key for browser search requests. Generate one via the Typesense API, or use the admin key for development (not recommended in production).

field.label: Index Prefix
field.comment: Short prefix for all collection names (e.g., 'rar' creates 'rar_product_default'). Useful when multiple environments share one Typesense server. Changing this after indexing requires a full reindex.

field.label: Frontend Search Protocol
field.comment: Frontend Search Node — Protocol for browser-side search requests. In Docker/Warden setups, this is usually 'https' via Traefik. Leave empty to use the server protocol above.

field.label: Frontend Search Host
field.comment: Frontend Search Node — Public hostname the browser uses to reach Typesense (e.g., 'typesense.mystore.test'). In Docker/Warden, this differs from the server host. Leave empty to use the server host above.

field.label: Frontend Search Port
field.comment: Frontend Search Node — Port for browser-side requests (e.g., 443 for HTTPS). Leave empty to use the server port above.

field.label: Batch Size
field.comment: Documents per import batch. Lower values use less memory but are slower. Default: 200. Increase to 500–1000 for large catalogs with sufficient memory.

field.label: Enable Customer Indexing
field.comment: Copies customer names, e-mail addresses and addresses into Typesense for the admin AI assistant. Keep disabled unless the assistant needs them: every customer save is reindexed. Remove existing collections with bin/magento typesense:collection:delete --entity=customer --force.

field.label: Enable Order Indexing
field.comment: Copies orders with customer names and e-mail addresses into Typesense for the admin AI assistant. Keep disabled unless the assistant needs them: every order save is reindexed. Remove existing collections with bin/magento typesense:collection:delete --entity=order --force.

field.label: Enable Store Indexing
field.comment: Indexes the store views for the admin AI assistant.

field.label: Enable System Configuration Indexing
field.comment: Indexes the system configuration for the admin AI assistant.

field.label: Enable Search Suggestions
field.comment: The suggestion index holds the queries Typesense's search analytics count on the product index (the Typesense server needs --enable-search-analytics). The TypeSense Suggestion indexer creates it and its analytics rule; bin/magento typesense:suggestions:seed imports existing Magento search terms.

field.label: Suggestion Limit
field.comment: How many of the most frequent queries the suggestion index keeps; Typesense drops the rest on every analytics flush. Applied on the next suggestion reindex.

field.label: Suggestion Minimum Count
field.comment: A query is shown in Suggestions and Popular Searches only after it was counted this often (seeded terms count with their Magento popularity). Raises the effort to push a term in.

field.label: Suggestion Maximum Length
field.comment: Longer queries are deleted from the suggestion index and never shown. Queries that are mostly not letters (numbers, links, e-mail addresses) are always removed.

field.label: Blocked Suggestion Words
field.comment: One word or word part per line, case-insensitive. Queries containing one are deleted from the suggestion index and never shown. The list is part of the storefront page source.

field.label: Suggestion Check Schedule
field.comment: Cron expression of the check that deletes blocked queries and shows only queries the search finds products for. New queries stay hidden until it has run.

field.label: Additional Attributes to Index
field.comment: Select product attributes to include in the Typesense index. Core fields (name, SKU, price, etc.) are always indexed. Changes require a full reindex.

field.label: Zero-Downtime Reindexing
field.comment: When enabled, indexing writes to a new collection, then swaps it live instantly. Your customers never see partial or empty results during reindex. Recommended for production.

field.label: Cron Schedule
field.comment: Standard cron expression. Examples: '0 2 * * *' (daily at 2 AM), '0 */6 * * *' (every 6 hours), '*/30 * * * *' (every 30 minutes).

field.label: Use Message Queue
field.comment: When enabled, full reindex jobs are dispatched to the message queue (RabbitMQ or MySQL) and processed asynchronously in the background.

field.label: Text Match Type
field.comment: How the text-match score is combined across the searched fields (Typesense text_match_type).

field.label: Searchable Attributes
field.comment: Attributes Typesense searches, with their weight (higher matches rank first). Attributes that are not indexed are ignored. Falls back to the product name when empty.

field.label: Drop Tokens Threshold
field.comment: If a query returns fewer results than this, words are dropped from the query to find more. 0 disables dropping.

field.label: Typo Tokens Threshold
field.comment: Typo-corrected matches are only searched when exact matches return fewer results than this.

field.label: Split/Join Words
field.comment: Also match "smart watch" against "smartwatch" and vice versa.

field.label: Exhaustive Search
field.comment: Let Typesense consider every matching token variant (typos, prefixes) instead of stopping once it found enough results. Finds more products on small catalogs, but makes searches slower on large ones.

field.label: Enable Prefix Search
field.comment: Match the last word of the query as a prefix (search-as-you-type).

field.label: Enable Infix Search
field.comment: Match query words inside other words (e.g. "phone" finds "smartphone") on the fields below. Requires a full reindex; searches can fail until it has finished.

field.label: Infix Search Fields
field.comment: Requires a full reindex; searches can fail until it has finished.

field.label: Infix Search Mode
field.comment: "Fallback" only uses infix matching when the exact search finds nothing; "Always" combines both. Takes effect without reindexing.

field.label: Enable Stemming
field.comment: Match word variants (e.g. "running" finds "run") in name, description, short description, categories and "Name (decompounded)". SKU and filter attributes are never stemmed. Requires a full reindex.

field.label: Show Direct Matches First
field.comment: Rank products that match the query itself above products found only through synonyms, on the search page and in autocomplete. Costs one extra search request per query.

field.label: Enable Server-Side Search Cache
field.comment: Typesense caches identical search requests in memory.

field.label: Boosting Rule Text Match Buckets
field.comment: Boosting rules reorder products only within the same text-match bucket. More buckets keep relevance closer to the query; fewer give the rules more influence. Default 10.

field.label: German Decompounding
field.comment: Index the product name with the tails of its German compound words (e.g. "Treppensackkarre" also as "Sackkarre" and "Karre") in the "Name (decompounded)" field. Enable it, run a full product reindex, and only then add a "Name (decompounded)" row under Searchable Attributes: adding the row before the reindex has finished makes every search in this store fail.

field.label: Never Split Words Of
field.comment: Words of this product attribute's value (e.g. a product line such as "Blackpool") are names and are never split. Requires a full reindex.

field.label: Product Tile Attributes
field.comment: Attributes to display on product cards in search results and category pages. Must also be in "Additional Attributes to Index".

field.label: Sort Options
field.comment: Sort options available to customers on search results and category pages, in this order. Attribute options list the product attributes with "Used for Sorting in Product Listing" = Yes; they need a full product reindex.

field.label: Facet Filters
field.comment: Product attributes to show as filters. The category filter (children of the current category, top-level categories on the search page) is always shown first. Only attributes marked as "Additional Attributes to Index" (and the core fields) will work as facets.

field.label: Facet Types
field.comment: How each facet filter is shown. A facet without a row is a dropdown, except "Price", which is a range slider. Checkbox works only for Yes/No fields (e.g. Availability) and the slider only for numeric fields; other combinations fall back to a dropdown. "Value Search" adds a search box to a dropdown's values.

field.label: Show Out-of-Stock Products Last
field.comment: Sorts in-stock products before out-of-stock ones under every sort option on search and category listings.

field.label: Replace Category Pages
field.comment: Use TypeSense for category product listings.

field.label: Cacheable Search Page
field.comment: Serve the search page as a full-page-cacheable shell (results load from TypeSense in the browser) when the URL holds only the query, listing state (page, sort, limit, price) and configured facet parameters. The browser still records each search term (Search Terms report and popularity), but Magento no longer stores the number of results for it. Search terms with a redirect URL still redirect; a redirect added later applies to an already cached query after the page cache is flushed.

field.label: No Results: Suggested Products Category ID
field.comment: When a search or category listing finds nothing, products of this category are shown below the message. Leave empty to show only the message.

field.label: SEO Text Selector
field.comment: CSS selector of the category SEO text, which is hidden on listing pages after the first to avoid duplicate content. Leave empty to never hide it.

field.label: Group Products By
field.comment: Faceted product field (e.g. an Additional Attribute shared by the variants of one product); the header search then shows one product per value. Ignored when the field is not in the product schema or not faceted. Leave empty to disable.

field.label: Product Meta Line Fields
field.comment: Comma-separated product document fields shown below a product's name, joined with " · " (e.g. categories.lvl1,volume_percent,color). Lists show their first value, category paths their last name, whole decimals without ".0". Leave empty for no meta line.

field.label: Show Cross-Sells of the Top Hit
field.comment: Shows the Magento cross-sell products of the first product hit, in stock and visible in the catalog. Needs a full product reindex after upgrading (crosssell_ids field).

field.label: Cross-Sell Fallback Attribute
field.comment: Product field (e.g. an Additional Attribute such as color); when the top hit has fewer cross-sells than the count, the rest is filled with products sharing one of its values. Ignored when the field is not in the product schema. Leave empty for no fallback.

field.label: Cross-Sell Fallback Sort
field.comment: Typesense sort_by of the fallback products, e.g. sales_count:desc (best sellers first).

field.label: Cross-Sell Meta Line Fields
field.comment: Like Product Meta Line Fields, for the cross-sell cards. Leave empty for no meta line.

field.label: Popular Searches Count
field.comment: The store's most popular search terms (from the suggestion index), also shown when the search opens with an empty input. 0 disables them.

field.label: Enable Conversational Search
field.comment: When enabled, search results include an AI-generated answer above the product grid. Requires OpenAI API key and Typesense v30+.

field.label: OpenAI API Key
field.comment: API key for generating conversational answers. Get one at platform.openai.com.

field.label: OpenAI Model
field.comment: The model used for generating answers. gpt-4o-mini is cheapest and fastest.

field.label: System Prompt
field.comment: Instructions for the AI assistant. Controls tone, scope, and behavior.

field.label: Embedding Source Fields
field.comment: Product fields used to generate semantic embeddings. Changes require a full product reindex.

field.label: Conversation TTL (seconds)
field.comment: How long conversation history is kept. Default: 86400 (24 hours).

field.label: Enable Admin AI Assistant
field.comment: Requires Conversational Search to be enabled with a valid OpenAI API key.

field.label: System Prompt
field.comment: Instructions for the AI assistant. Describe what data it has access to and how it should respond.

field.label: OpenAI Model
field.comment: Leave empty to inherit from Conversational Search settings.

field.label: Conversation TTL (seconds)
field.comment: How long conversation history is retained. Default: 86400 (24 hours).

group.label: Product Recommendations
group.comment: Requires Conversational Search to be enabled — recommendations reuse the product embeddings it generates.

field.label: Enable Recommendations
field.comment: Show similar products on the product detail page using vector search.

field.label: Number of Products
field.comment: Maximum number of recommended products to display. Default: 8.

field.label: Push GA4 Events to the dataLayer
field.comment: view_item_list, select_item, search_suggestion_click, sorting_interaction and filter_interaction from the listing and the header search. Leave off when a theme maps the typesense:* window events itself.
